faq.q: Does Titanium Spoke Nipple require special assembly or anti-seize?
faq.a: Yes. Titanium-to-titanium threaded interfaces on Titanium Spoke Nipple are susceptible to galling (cold welding) during assembly. Application of MoS₂ or copper-based anti-seize compound to all threaded contact surfaces is mandatory. Lubricated installation torque values are typically 15-20% lower than dry values. Thread engagement should not exceed 3× thread diameter.
